articles.title: Holly Madison blasts ‘puppet masters’ for Playboy girlfriends’ feud
articles.summary: Holly Madison revealed she'd embrace manufactured drama on a "Real Housewives of Las Vegas" but refuses to be "puppeted" like on "Girls Next Door."
articles.body: Holly Madison has no problem with reality TV drama — as long as everyone is in on the joke. The "Girls Next Door" alum told Fox News Digital she would "100%" embrace manufactured conflict on a show like "Real Housewives of Las Vegas," but claimed manipulation by the "puppet masters" behind her former series contributed to lasting rifts among the cast. For years, Madison had seemingly closed the door on reality television, previously saying she would never return after her experience on "The Girls Next Door." But with time and a different perspective on how manufactured drama could work, she admitted she has reconsidered that hard-line stance. "You know what, I've changed my thought on that," the Grant a Gift Gala ambassador explained. "I would do manufactured drama if I was in on the joke. I always say that to Bridgette watching 'Girls Next Door,' I'm like, if we knew what the drama was and the three of us were gonna play it out on screen and not take it home with us, so to speak, when the cameras are done rolling, that would have been so much more fun to me than being manipulated from the puppet masters above." HOLLY MADISON SAYS PLAYBOY MANSION FELT LIKE A 'SAFE HARBOR' AFTER SHE ENCOUNTERED HOLLYWOOD'S DARK SIDE "Some of us from the cast are still not speaking today because of things like that, so. I would actually do manufactured drama, 100%. I would throw down on like a 'Real Housewives of Las Vegas.' I just don't want to be puppeted again." The former reality star also pointed to another major difference between the television landscape then and now: the audience. "Editing's crazy," she noted. "But I also appreciate that viewers are a little more sophisticated now. I mean, back in the 'Girls Next Door' days, they could edit something to be not what it was. And everybody watching was like, 'Nope, that's your character. That's who you are.'" WATCH: HOLLY MADISON SAYS SHE'D EMBRACE ‘MANUFACTURED DRAMA’ ON REALITY TV UNDER ONE CONDITION ‘DUCK DYNASTY’ STAR SADIE ROBERTSON HUFF ADMITS ‘FEARS’ OVER PUTTING HER KIDS ON REALITY TV There is one non-negotiable for the former Playboy model. "I would never put my kids on TV, ever, ever, ever," she told Fox News Digital. Madison shares a daughter, Rainbow, and a son, Forest, with ex-husband Pasquale Rotella. She said her kids know bits and pieces about her Playboy past, but the once-iconic brand barely registers with their generation. "So it's all kind of vague, and they don't see it as like a bad thing. Like anytime it's brought up or mentioned, it's kind of laughed about," Madison added. "So I'm glad that whoever's bringing it to their attention or bringing it up — because it's not me or their dad — whoever's bringing it up is bringing it up like it's a positive or a cool thing or a funny thing. It's not like bad or shameful or gross or anything." HOLLY MADISON EXPOSES HUGH HEFNER’S ALLEGED 'CULT-LIKE' TACTICS, 'WEIRD' GROUP SEX NIGHTS AT PLAYBOY MANSION Madison became a household name through her years at the Playboy Mansion and her relationship with Playboy founder Hugh Hefner. She later moved to Las Vegas, headlined the stage production "Peepshow" and starred in her own reality series, "Holly’s World." Madison also became a bestselling author: her 2015 memoir, "Down the Rabbit Hole," debuted at No. 1 on The New York Times bestseller list. But Madison’s perspective on those years has continued to evolve. An autism diagnosis later in life gave her a new framework for understanding everything from the people she gravitated toward to why she thrived in certain environments and struggled in others. She was formally diagnosed with autism in 2023, although she had speculated for years she might be on the spectrum. articles.body: Abhishek Pathak's crime thriller 'Drishyam 3' has crossed Rs 340 crore at the worldwide box office, and actor Ajay Devgn says its different storyline from the Malayalam film was not a rebellion. The Hindi version, which released after Jeetu Joseph's Malayalam film earlier this year, followed its own route, and Ajay Devgn feels it was a natural chain of events.Is 'Drishyam 4' on the cards?The Malayalam version, starring Mohanlal, did not get the strong response the franchise is known for, and Jeethu Joseph seems to be working on a fourth part. Although 'Drishyam 3' was billed as 'The Conclusion', Ajay Devgn hinted that the makers, like his clever character Vijay Salgaonkar, may have a trick up their sleeve."At the moment, it is a conclusion," Ajay Devgn told Gulf News, before adding, "I can't predict it." When pressed, he did not rule out another film. "The decision was, this is the conclusion. The decision right now is that this is the conclusion… Right now," he added.Hindi and Malayalam teams shared their scriptsAfter Abhishek Pathak and his father, Kumar Mangat Pathak, Panorama Studios acquired the franchise from the Malayalam makers, the two teams began working together. During the interview, Ajay Devgn revealed, "Honestly speaking, they had not decided to make a third one. We were toying with the idea, and I think all the writers worked out some ideas, and they didn't work. And finally, things fell into place."He added, "We spoke to them, and we were like, 'Let's make it; we have a script.' And then they said that they're also working on something, and they had a script. So we thought, 'Let's hear each of her out and decide what to do.'"The Hindi writers Abhishek Pathak, Aamii Keeyan Khan and Parveez Shaikh then exchanged scripts with Joseph, the writer of the Malayalam film.Why the Hindi team stuck to its own scriptAjay Devgn added, "Finally we came to the conclusion that this is a fabulous script, but it is most suited for their audience. And we were very confident about our script. So, then we decided that we will go ahead," recalled Devgn. "When you work hard and then you get something which is to the point, then you're confident enough to make it the way you want to make it."More about 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion'The cast also includes Tabu, Rajat Kapoor, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Jaideep Ahlawat, Prakash Raj and Kamlesh Sawant. articles.title: Michael Douglas rompe su silencio sobre una supuesta adicción al sexo: "No sé si me acosté con tantas mujeres"
articles.standfirst: El actor ha desmontado este mito durante la promoción de su autobiografía
articles.summary: El actor ha desmontado este mito durante la promoción de su autobiografía
articles.body: A sus 82 años, el actor estadounidense Michael Douglas ha roto su silencio sobre los históricos rumores de los años 90 sobre su supuesta adicción al sexo. Con motivo de la promoción de su primera autobiografía, titulada ‘One Helluva Ride’, el doble ganador del Oscar abordó el tema en una entrevista concedida al periódico británico The Times. El actor calificó la historia como una invención de los medios de comunicación y bromeó con la persistencia del mito: "No sé si me acosté con tantas mujeres. Yo no lo veo así. No, yo no. Yo era un producto sano de los años 60", ha afirmado, destacando que le parecía "curioso" que "los británicos estuvieran tan obsesionados con los temas sexuales". En concreto, Douglas atribuyó el origen del rumor a la prensa británica: "A un editor de un tabloide británico se le ocurrió esta historia, de la que, muchas gracias, aquí estamos hablando a mis 82 años". Con esto, desmiente de forma categórica que su ingreso en una clínica de rehabilitación en 1992 se debiera a una adicción sexual. A pesar de negar la adicción, el protagonista de ‘Instinto básico’ comparte detalles llamativos sobre su vida sentimental en el libro. Por ejemplo, habla de sus inicios con Catherine Zeta-Jones, confesando que cuando empezó a verse con su actual esposa, salía simultáneamente con otras cinco mujeres en ciudades distintas. Sin embargo, al formalizar su relación, Catherine Zeta-Jones le exigió exclusividad. "Ella me dijo que, si íbamos a seguir con esto, quería que fuera una relación monógama. Así que esa misma noche llamé a algunas mujeres con las que estaba saliendo, y ahí se acabó", relata el intérprete. Finalmente, en sus memorias también desvela facetas desconocidas de su pasado amoroso, incluyendo una relación sentimental con la actriz Kathleen Turner, quien fue su compañera de reparto en la icónica película ‘Tras el corazón verde’.

articles.title: Brad Pitt’s rise to fame: From Oklahoma’s suburbs to $400 million net worth; here’s all you need to know about the ‘F1’ star
articles.summary: Discover the rise of Brad Pitt from his humble beginnings in Oklahoma to becoming one of Hollywood's most celebrated actors, with insights into his personal life, major roles, and accomplishments including his $400 million net worth.
articles.body: Brad Pitt is one of Hollywood’s most iconic actors and influential producers, evolving from a heartthrob in the 1990s into a critically acclaimed Academy Award winner. Pitt has come a long way in his career, starting from almost nothing to now having a net worth of USD 400 million. Here is a look into his early life, his entry into the Hollywood industry, and how he became one of the most beloved stars in the industry.Brad Pitt’s early life and entry into the industryBrad Pitt was born as William Bradley Pitt on December 18, 1963, in Shawnee, Oklahoma, though he was raised in Springfield, Missouri. From a young age, Pitt grew up in a conservative Southern Baptist household and attended the University of Missouri, majoring in journalism with a focus on advertising. He had been interested in acting from a young age; however, he still went to college for a degree.However, just two weeks before he would have completed his degree in 1986, Pitt dropped out and drove all the way to Los Angeles to pursue acting seriously. In his early years in LA, to make ends meet, he often worked odd jobs, which included things like driving limousines, moving refrigerators, and dressing as a giant chicken for El Pollo Loco.Brad Pitt’s entry into Hollywood and his breakthrough roleThe actor made his acting debut in May 1987 when he scored a two-episode role on the soap opera ‘Another World,' while his feature film debut as a lead in the 1989 slasher movie ‘Cutting Class.’ His breakthrough came years later in 1991, when he played the role of the drifter J.D. in Ridley Scott's ‘Thelma & Louise.’ Following the release of this film, the star started booking major projects left and right.Some of his other critically acclaimed roles include ‘A River Runs Through It’ (1992), ‘Interview with the Vampire’ (1994), and ‘Legends of the Fall’ (1994). He later earned his first Oscar nomination for ‘12 Monkeys’ (1995). What solidified his career was his feature in ‘Fight Club’ (1999), along with Steven Soderbergh's ‘Ocean's Eleven’ (2001) franchise.Brad Pitt’s stint as a producerBeyond acting, the star also dabbled in producing films and gained critical acclaim for his work in ‘Moneyball’ (2011), and later won his first Academy Award for Best Picture as a producer on ‘12 Years a Slave’ (2013), which was followed by an Oscar for Best Supporting Actor in ‘Once Upon a Time in Hollywood’ (2019).About Brad Pitt’s personal lifeOn the personal front, Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie’s relationship was heavily publicized, from the moment they started dating to their separation and their ongoing legal battle over their jointly owned vineyard. He was also once engaged to Gwyneth Paltrow and was briefly married to Jennifer Aniston from 2000 to 2005.He married Jolie in 2014 after years of staying together for years before that. The couple filed for divorce in 2016, and their settlement was finalized on December 30, 2024, ending an eight-year legal battle. As for their family, Pitt shares six children with Angelina Jolie: Maddox, Pax, Zahara, Shiloh, Knox, and Vivienne; however, he is estranged from all of his children after the two filed for divorce. Five of his children have also dropped his surname from their legal names and now only go by their mother’s last name.Brad Pitt is currently in a relationship with jewelry executive Ines de Ramon. The pair have been linked since late 2022, marking over three and a half years together. The two are quite serious since they live together in Los Angeles, though they have chosen to keep a relatively low-drama, grounded profile throughout their relationship. Despite all of this, the two often accompany one another to public events to show their support for their significant other. Many reports have also shared that while the couple is going strong, they have not thought about marriage or anything related to that for now.On the work front, his latest film, ‘Heart of the Beast,' was recently released in theaters worldwide.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Queen Camilla is mourning the deaths of her doctor, Hannah Cain, and author Lord Jeffrey Archer, with Dr. Cain being found dead at her home and her husband, Mark Cain, arrested and charged with her murder.

Queen Camilla is mourning many losses, including the deaths of her doctor, Hannah Cain, and author Lord Jeffrey Archer.

According to Page Six , Dr. Cain was killed while throwing a sleepover for her three children and their friends on Sunday, Oct. 4, 2026. The outlet reported that she was found dead at her home and appeared to have suffered "blunt force injury to the right side of her head." Dr. Cain also reportedly sustained an injury "that could be suggestive of compression of the neck."

On October 7, prosecutors confirmed that Dr. Cain's husband, Mark Cain, has been arrested and charged with her murder. Authorities have not yet identified a motive, and Detective Insp Alix Wright confirmed that police are "in the very early stages of this investigation, working to establish the exact circumstances surrounding the woman's death."

Still, Wright urged people to come forward if they believe that "they may have information that could help our investigation."

Sources told The Sun that Camilla and King Charles have been informed of Dr. Cain's death, but they have yet to release a statement about the tragedy.

Camilla is also grieving the death of Lord Jeffrey Archer, a former politician and bestselling author who died "suddenly and peacefully at his home" on Monday, October 5. He was 86.

In a statement per Hello! , the Queen said, "Seldom does an author get to live a life as rich, varied and colourful as any of the characters in their books, or with as many surprising plot twists."

"While he was not without flaw, his friends will recall him as an irrepressible life force through all the many differing chapters of his life," the statement continued. "Wherever the next page turns to, I trust there will be champagne and shepherd's pie in abundance."

The source noted that Charles' "instinct was simply to reach out privately, express his concern and ask whether there was anything he could do." However, not being able to "establish contact has been incredibly upsetting."

"For somebody of the King's position to make a personal effort like that and then find the door effectively closed was difficult," they added. "His concern has always been for his friend's welfare."

Anton Bowring, also an explorer, reportedly reached out to Buckingham Palace sometime in 2025 and revealed that Fiennes was "in a very poor state." Charles' then-equerry, William Thornton, allegedly told Bowring that the King "was most concerned" and wanted to write to Fiennes and his family to offer help. However, Fiennes' wife, Louise Millington-Cotes, turned down the request because she "apparently had issues with their personal information being shared."

articles.summary: Aamir Khan has shared his thoughts on the rising use of AI in films, at a time when Janhvi Kapoor's deepfake controversy has sparked concern.
articles.body: Aamir Khan has shared his thoughts on the rising use of AI in films, at a time when Janhvi Kapoor's deepfake controversy has sparked concern. Speaking to the media, he said the outcome depends on how filmmakers use the technology.Aamir Khan on how cinema is handling AIAsked how cinema has responded to AI, the 'Laagan' actor said it is up to makers to build a good product with technology. He added that technology has no life of its own and that people are the ones who give it shape.According to IANS, Aamir Khan said, "When a new technology comes, it is easily absorbed in films. Those who use it well get good results. Those who don't use it well don't get positive reactions. So, it really depends on how you use it. Technology is a technology. There is no life in it."The 'PK' actor said AI has made it far easier for filmmakers to bring their wildest ideas to life.He added, "Even if it is VFX, even if it is AI, it is almost the same. As far as a filmmaker, there was a time when you could not do what you had in your mind because the facilities and technology were not so advanced. Today, you can show whatever you can imagine. So, it is a tool which you should know how to use well."The Janhvi Kapoor deepfake controversyRecently, a morphed video of Janhvi Kapoor from the 'Devara' song 'Chuttamalle' surfaced on social media, raising serious concerns about the misuse of AI.Jr NTR warns of legal actionJr NTR condemned the fake video and warned of legal action against those misusing AI. Calling the makers "disgusting, sick and shameless", the 'RRR' star said, "In a land that worships women as mothers and goddesses, where "Matrudevo Bhava" is not just a phrase but a part of our culture, some people have fallen so low that they are using AI to disrespect a woman in the most degrading way possible. Using AI to create something this vile is shameful beyond words. To the scumbags behind this morphed Chuttamalle video, I will not spare any of you. I will take every possible legal action against those who created it and those who are spreading it."Aamir Khan's work frontAamir Khan will next feature in Ashutosh Gowariker's 'Lalkaara'. articles.title: 'Saved by the Bell' star Dennis Haskins' cause of death revealed: report
articles.summary: Dennis Haskins' death certificate lists Parkinson's disease and other significant conditions the 75-year-old "Saved by the Bell" actor faced.
articles.body: Dennis Haskins, best known for starring as Principal Richard Belding on "Saved by the Bell," died on Sept. 27, and his cause of death has now been revealed. The actor died from Parkinson's disease at a hospital in Burbank, California, according to a death certificate obtained by TMZ. He was 75. The Los Angeles County Department of Public Health document lists Parkinson's disease as the immediate cause of death. Irritable bowel syndrome, depression, hypertension and benign prostatic hyperplasia were also listed as other significant conditions. ‘SAVED BY THE BELL’ STAR DENNIS HASKINS DEAD AT 75 Haskins' representative previously confirmed his death to Fox News Digital, describing the actor as a beloved friend who maintained a special connection with his fans. "It's a tragic loss. Everyone loved Mr. Belding and those of us who got to know Dennis loved him even more. He was a great person, and he loved, I mean absolutely LOVED his fans. He always had time for them, no matter what. He was my client and dear friend for over 20 years, and I will miss him terribly. I'm heartbroken." ‘DAYS OF OUR LIVES’ STAR ROBERT KELKER-KELLY DEAD AT 62 Haskins' former "Saved by the Bell" co-stars remembered the actor, who became a familiar and reassuring presence during their teenage years on the series. Elizabeth Berkley, who portrayed Jessie Spano, reflected on the special relationship Haskins had with the young cast. "I started Saved by the Bell when I was 15 years old. We were six teenagers at such a formative and impressionable time in our lives. Dennis was kind, protective and deeply caring. He gave us space to be ourselves and to figure out who we were becoming, while always making us feel that he was there if we needed him," she posted on her Instagram with a photo of her "Saved by the Bell" co-stars. "He treated us as equals, as the professionals that we were. He respected and trusted us. He was an incredible scene partner who cared deeply about the craft, the work, and about us. You could feel it in the way he showed up, both as an actor and as a person. Mr. Belding couldn’t have been anyone else. So much of what made him so loved came from Dennis’s inherent goodness, the same goodness we were lucky enough to receive and be around every day." Tiffani Thiessen, who played Kelly Kapowski, also remembered Haskins as a steady presence during her teenage years. "Dennis Haskins was a steady presence in my teenage years, the kind of figure who kept us in line while making sure we knew he was in our corner. I will always remember his kindness and be grateful for the memories we as a cast got to share with him. RIP Mr. B." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? articles.title: Travis Barker shares worrying photos from hospital as wife Kourtney Kardashian and daughter Alabama stay by his side
articles.summary: Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker has shared photos from a hospital bed on Instagram, worrying fans.
articles.body: Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker has shared photos from a hospital bed on Instagram, worrying fans. His wife, Kourtney Kardashian, and daughter Alabama Barker were by his side. He has not revealed why he was hospitalised.Travis Barker shares photos from the hospital bedTravis Barker, 50, posted the pictures on his Instagram Story on Tuesday. They showed him in a blue gown, surgical cap and medical bracelet, with an IV in his arm and a blood pressure monitor nearby. Sharing a selfie with Alabama, 20, he wrote, "My baby girl came with me," Barker captioned the photo.He then posted a picture of himself kissing Kardashian from the bed, captioned, "And my beautiful wife by my side."Reason for the visit has not been revealedTravis Barker did not share why he was in hospital, though the photos suggest he was getting ready for a procedure. Page Six reached out to his representative for comment but did not immediately hear back.A look back at his 2022 health scareTravis Barker was rushed to hospital in June 2022 after an endoscopy led to life-threatening pancreatitis. He wrote on his Instagram Story at the time, "I went in for an endoscopy Monday feeling great. But after dinner, I developed excruciating pain and have been hospitalised ever since."He said doctors removed a "small polyp" from a "very sensitive area usually handled by specialists, which unfortunately damaged a critical pancreatic drainage tube."A lighter post and a blended familySoon after the hospital photos, Travis Barker shared a video of his and Kardashian's son, Rocky, 2, riding an inflatable dinosaur. It was set to John Williams' 'Jurassic Park' theme.The couple has a blended family. Kardashian has three children with ex-husband Scott Disick: Mason, 16, Penelope, 14, and Reign, 11.
